name: nflverse historical rosters, roster_{year}.csv 1920-2026
_not_the_same_source_as_nflverse: declarations/nflverse.json covers players.csv and its DRAFT records. This covers the 107 per-season roster files. Different body, different id, so neither ingest can silently absorb the other.

WHAT_IS_INGESTED.birth_date: near-total before 1950 -- 96.7% of the 1920s, 99.5% of the 1930s, 100.0% of the 1940s. This is the join and the reason the source is worth holding.
WHAT_IS_INGESTED.roster_membership: person on a club in a season. A THIRD voice beside StatsCrew and PFA for the pre-1950 era, where the archive had two.

WHAT_IS_REFUSED_AND_WHY.headshot_url: MEASURED 2026-09-06 and REFUSED. Present on 100% of rows in every decade, which is why it looks valuable. 15 of 20 sampled URLs -- fifteen DIFFERENT urls -- return one byte-identical file: 382,225 bytes, PNG 1400x1000, md5 f63433b569d11ff3..., a generic helmeted silhouette. A url is not an image. Ingesting it would record 11,701 pre-1950 photographs that do not exist.
WHAT_IS_REFUSED_AND_WHY.position: MEASURED and REFUSED. The archive holds 324 distinct position codes before 1950; this source holds 19. On 8,700 comparable season-pairs the archive is more specific 796 times and this source 42. It also collapses WB, TB, BB and FB to a single HB on 2,112 rows. Ingesting it would add noise to a field the archive already carries better.
WHAT_IS_REFUSED_AND_WHY.college: REFUSED. 0.0% populated before 1980. The field exists and is empty for every pre-1950 row.
WHAT_IS_REFUSED_AND_WHY.depth_chart_position: REFUSED with position. Zero rows in 1920-1940 contain a '/' -- it is one code per row, not the per-season multi-position data it was hoped to be.

IDENTITY._name_alone_is_a_bug: 2,470 nflverse people match an archive name uniquely and would be a GUESS; 286 match a name shared by two or more archive people and would be a BUG. Neither route is used.
routes: name + birth_date, unique in the archive
birth_date alone, unique in the archive
IDENTITY.unmatched_are_LEADS: A person this source holds and the archive does not is a LEAD, not a person. Same structure as the PFA and media-guide leads. Promotion is a ruling.

DISAGREEMENTS.rule: HELD, never resolved. Both values stay and neither is preferred.
DISAGREEMENTS._the_join_is_never_the_field_compared: Matching on birth date and then comparing birth dates proves nothing. Disagreements are found on a join of unique archive name plus at least one shared season.

games: ABSENT BY CONSTRUCTION. 30 columns and not one is a game, start or snap count. There is nothing here to compare against StatsCrew on games.
